easyPrerequisites:
You control three or more lands that share a name.
You control three additional Islands.
description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping them, adding {U} and three mana of any color.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.
